And the recent extremes of oxygen depletion do not obviously track a land-based supply that DCE put 51% lower - though a comparison of chosen years cannot tell no effect from worse without, and warming works against the reduction. The page states that this does not exonerate agriculture, that multiplying unknown fractions yields an unknown rather than a small one, and that it is not an argument for inaction.
